reason: The pair logic holds, but the finding as written copies another one, has a wrong premise, and includes an option we cannot build. (1) VALUE: in the E10 branch the twin (x138 + safetail + lowrefine, about x138 on nodes) mostly duplicates what the successor already covers (x138 + X, no insertion). If X does not transfer to private, successor ~ x138 ~ twin, so the twin's option value is ~0. K2 still adds the insertion's private upside (LB delta 0 / +0.001 twice, #35 and #37; the R2 private break-even is favourable). The twin beats K2 as a hedge only if both X and the insertion hurt private. So {successor, K2} is the right pair. Expected gain is only ~P(trigger 0.05-0.10, down from 0.15-0.2 per round7/scan_hypotheses) x ~2-3e-4 = ~1-3e-5. The real benefit is avoiding a post-hoc pair choice. (2) DUPLICATE: round7/scan_plancheck.json PC7-02 already proposes a full 'E10 PORT RULE' with the same pair {port, K2 #37}, plus trigger, build, ledger, R5 and OK scope. r7h-4 is a subset of it. (3) PREMISE FLAW: 'by R4 the successor becomes F1' is false under the written rules. §f(iii) requires C01 in F1. A verbatim port cannot carry C01: tools/build_probe_kernel.py has only the exp39/x138 bases (BASES l.99), and safetail/lowrefine exit unless --base x138 (l.2027/2046). R5(a) holds only if the port keeps x138's REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = 27000 guard (7.5 h). So F1 status needs an explicit §f(iii) waiver [OK] and a proven R5. (4) FEASIBILITY: the pair line costs nothing and needs no code, so it is fine. The optional 'successor + insertion' build is not feasible. It needs a new builder base (new code, a new mechanism), and the trigger-to-score lead time is 8-11 h. It would be an unscored stack that R4 cannot admit on lab gain, and the practical R8 window leaves no room for it.
fix: Do not add a separate r7h-4 line. Fold its pair clause into the PC7-02 'E10 PORT RULE (pre-trigger)' and get ONE conditional user OK before any trigger. Clause: 'If a verbatim E10 port is scored without error, R5(a) L_hi <= 7.5 h (keeps x138's REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = 27000; otherwise R5 UNPROVEN -> not adopted) and public >= K2 + 0.002 (>= 0.956), the pair = {port, K2 #37 56563521}. The twin #38 leaves. §f(iii) (C01) is waived for the port only [OK]. Otherwise the pair stays {#37, #38}. Never {port, twin}, never port + #34, and never two byte-identical files.' Drop the optional 'successor + insertion' build: no builder base exists, it would be new code after the practical R8 window, and it would be an unscored stack. Log the OK time before any trigger so the rule counts as pre-registered (W1-style).
realistic_gain: ~+1e-5 to +3e-5 expected on private (P(trigger) ~5-10% x ~2-3e-4 option-value difference between K2 and the twin as the hedge next to the successor). Main value is procedural: no post-hoc pair choice if E10 fires. Cost 0 (one CONTEXT clause inside PC7-02 plus one conditional OK).
